card.name: Institutions slow to catch up
card.fires_on: Words in a sentence saying some group or institution has been slow, late or has not yet adapted to change, such as 'slow', 'yet', 'catch' before 'to' or 'up'. It marks the spot just before 'to change', 'catch up' or 'wake up'.

modes.label: Slow to adopt
modes.description: The word 'slow' or 'yet' after 'have been' or 'have', before 'to' plus a verb of change.
modes.example: U.S. ballet companies were<< slow>> to acquire it; the first was Boston

modes.label: Catch up or wake up
modes.description: The verb leading into 'up' when an institution is urged to catch up or wake up.
modes.example: why is it taking so long for institutions to<< catch>> up?

modes.label: Lagging subject or auxiliary
modes.description: The subject or auxiliary verb in a sentence saying a group has not yet evolved or is lagging.
modes.example: the laws that govern radio royalty payments<< have>> not evolved at the same pace.

card.writes: It promotes wake and awakening words, suggesting the text is about being late to wake up to change.
card.plain: It lights up when text says an institution is behind and slow to catch up or wake up to change.
